briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus accelerate AGI race as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen models amid record funding and regulatory scrutiny. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments while geopolitical compute controls tighten.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2T parameters; Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and Google Gemini 3 now in limited preview. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while xAI Colossus cluster hits 1M H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines mandate red-teaming for all models above 100B parameters.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm process for AI chips; Microsoft and Oracle announce $40B joint data center buildout in Texas. NVIDIA Blackwell supply remains constrained through Q1 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI system emerge from a US lab or a multinational consortium by 2028?
